To satisfy both the new Payments and Customer APIs naming (`createdAt`, `amountCents`) and the existing consumer contracts (`placedAt`, `totalCents`), the [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L29) event now dual-emits both sets of fields.

### Summary of Changes

1. **[`src/core/events.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/src/core/events.ts)**:
   - Added `placedAt` alongside `createdAt` on [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L29).
   - Added `totalCents` alongside `amountCents` on [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L29).
   - In [`orderPlaced(order)`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/src/core/events.ts#L46-L65), populated `placedAt: order.placedAt` and `totalCents: total` alongside `createdAt` and `amountCents`.
2. **Tests**:
   - **[`test/adapters.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/test/adapters.test.ts#L50-L54)**: Verified that serialized Kafka payloads contain both new (`amountCents`, `createdAt`) and legacy (`totalCents`, `placedAt`) fields.
   - **[`test/app.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w7/r/test/app.test.ts#L21-L54)**: Updated event assertions to verify both sets of fields.
